label: Index, ratings, and market-data fee croupiers

orientation.note: Sticky subscription and benchmark fees. VIX/SPY vol are weak activity proxies only — not ASV or retention.

interference.physics_note: Fee contracts and benchmark IP are legal/economic claims, not physical capacity bottlenecks.
interference.economic_note: Sticky subscriptions can weather volume dips; soft constraint is client budgets and benchmark reform.
interference.controlled_failures_note: One quarter of soft equity vol is path noise, not theme falsification.

reinforcement.recursive_note: Fee croupiers compound via switching costs more than recursive scarcity loops.

expected_value_note: Context only. Do not treat VIX floors as proof of index-fee quality.
